_what_this_is: Tracked, sanitized evidence for the fee tier that pipeline/fees.py CURRENT_SCHEDULE encodes. The probe's own report lives at logs/stf_cost_report_2026-09-22.json, which .gitignore excludes, so a fresh checkout could not otherwise inspect the evidence behind an operational money constant.
_scope: OPERATIONAL ONLY. This is a current-account measurement adopted for prospective paper/shadow accounting. It is not a research artifact, it is not in any registered code-path list, and it says nothing about what any account paid during the 2020-2026 research periods.
_supersedes: docs/operations/fee_tier_2026-09-15.json (schedule_id coinbase-intro-1-2026-09, Intro 1, 0.6%/1.2%). That schedule stays registered in pipeline/fees.py so trades opened under it keep reconciling under it; it is no longer what active_schedule() returns.
accounting_effective_from_note: A SELECTED accounting-boundary timestamp (00:00 UTC on the day the 4-reading cohort completed), not the instant this schedule went operationally live and not consulted by pipeline/fees.py:active_schedule() at rate-resolution time. It precedes the last supporting reading (2026-09-22T00:05:02Z) by five minutes because it marks the day of confirmation, not a to-the-minute cutover. Actual operational adoption is the date this change merged to main -- see the repository's commit/PR history for that date, not this field.

source_report.why_untracked: logs/ is excluded by .gitignore line 30; the digest and the facts below are what survives a checkout

gap.reason: the daily probe's scheduled task failed to wake the machine (WakeToRun) on both dates; no observation was recorded for either day, and none was fabricated or interpolated to fill the gap
gap.precedent: the prior cohort (2026-09-11..09-15) also had a one-day gap on 2026-09-13. The adoption criterion has always been four readings with no tier change between them, not four consecutive calendar days -- a gap does not reset the count as long as every reading actually collected agrees

evidence.credential: view-only key, permissions re-verified against the exchange per reading (can_view true, can_trade false, can_transfer false)
evidence.how_confirmed: backtesting/stf_cost_probe.py --report, run against the tracked logs/stf_cost_probe.jsonl (local, no network) on 2026-09-22; fee_tier.observed_tiers shows exactly one 'Intro' entry (4 observations, first_seen 2026-09-17T00:05:04Z, last_seen 2026-09-22T00:05:02Z) and tier_changed_during_the_probe reflects the full observation history, which still includes the superseded Intro 1 readings from 2026-09-11..09-16 -- it is not evidence of a change within this cohort

how_to_reverify: a different tier means the account moved: add a NEW schedule with a new id and effective date in pipeline/fees.py, and leave this one in place so trades placed under it keep settling under it
not_permanent: Coinbase tiers move with trailing volume. These are current measured values for one account in September 2026, not Coinbase constants.
